parse.title: St. Jerry
parse.text:
St. Jerry
Type
NPC
Abiphone
✔ Yes
Description
Rewards the player with a  Green Gift after they find the  20 White Gifts scattered around  Jerry's Workshop.
Location
 Jerry's Workshop
Coordinates
-22.5 76 92.5

St. Jerry is an NPC located in  Jerry's Workshop. If the player finds all  20 White Gifts scattered around Jerry's Workshop, they will be rewarded with a Green Gift.

Contents

  • 1 Interface
  • 2 Dialogue
  • 3 Trivia
  • 4 History
  • 5 Navigation

Interface

[edit | edit source]
Claim Reward

Dialogue

[edit | edit source]
Condition Dialogue
Welcome to  Jerry's Workshop
[NPC] St. Jerry: 'Tis the Season of Jerry, [player]!
[NPC] St. Jerry: You may have noticed some Gifts laying around.
[NPC] St. Jerry: Each SkyBlock year, I place them throughout the village to spread joy and good tidings.
[NPC] St. Jerry: Find them all and come back to me!
 0–5 White Gifts Found
[NPC] St. Jerry: Find all of the Gifts around the village and come back to me!
 6–10 White Gifts Found
[NPC] St. Jerry: I see you've found some Gifts, but there are still many more in the village. Find the rest and come back for a reward!
 11–15 White Gifts Found
[NPC] St. Jerry: You're getting there, [player]! Find the rest of the Gifts and come back for a reward!
 16–18 White Gifts Found
[NPC] St. Jerry: You're so close! Find # more Gifts and come back to me!
 19 White Gifts Found
[NPC] St. Jerry: You're so close! Find the last Gift and come back for a reward!
All  20 White Gifts Found
[NPC] St. Jerry: You found all of the Gifts!
[NPC] St. Jerry: Take this Green Gift! You'll hopefully find something nicer than what was in those White Gifts!
[NPC] St. Jerry: If you haven't already, be sure to give your other Gifts away to others. Giving Gifts benefits both you and the receiver!
Abiphone Contact None
[NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ Of course I can add you as a contact!
[NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ I have # contacts on my Abiphone.
[NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ It's a really big Abiphone!
[NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ If you want my contact, all you have to do is repeat this phrase exactly...
[NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ "I love the warmth of the Holidays despite the snow"
Repeating Phrase
[NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ That's grandiose!
[NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ I really like you!
[NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ Call me every year and I'll hand you a White Gift!
Calling
First Time This Year
[NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ I sent a gift to your inventory! With love, St. Jerry.
Calling
Already Received White Gift
[NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ You've already recieved[sic<
abbr>]<
sup> a gift this year!
[NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ But hey, merry season of the Jerry to you anyway!
[NPC] St. Jerry: ✆ Call me again next year!
 The Garden None
[NPC] St. Jerry: Golly gee - I want to spread joy around the world, in the form of raw materials!
Completing
[NPC] St. Jerry: Your help has been the greatest gift of all.
Denying
[NPC] St. Jerry: Without your help, I can only supply plain white gifts this holiday.
Condition Random Dialogue
Reward Already Claimed
[NPC] St. Jerry: Did you know you can access your Bank from Jerry's Workshop? Check out the Bank in the center of the village!
[NPC] St. Jerry: Click someone with a Gift to give both you and them a Gift!
[NPC] St. Jerry: Come back next SkyBlock year to find more Gifts!
[NPC] St. Jerry: Ice fishing is a great way to relax during the winter!
[NPC] St. Jerry: There are all sorts of icy creatures within the depths of Jerry Pond!
[NPC] St. Jerry: You can trade Gifts directly with others or randomly gift players on the island!
[NPC] St. Jerry: Gifting others benefits both you and the other person!

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • St. Jerry cannot be given a  Bachelor's Rose during Jerry's Workshop if the Defend Jerry's Workshop event is not active.
